title: SCiO professional accreditation and competency framework
check: Accreditation page and its public competency portfolio, v11 February 2025, inspected. The portfolio distinguishes learning exercises from application in organisations.
use: Check the 13 approaches, three theory rows and application context; use the official linked portfolio for assessment.

title: SCiO competency self-assessment portfolio (PDF)
check: Public sharing and downloadable access confirmed; the three-page text was read. Footer identifies v11 February 2025.
use: Authoritative row names for the coverage register. No claim of SCiO endorsement of this pack.

title: SCiO competency framework resource guide (PDF)
check: Public sharing confirmed; approach and theory bibliography inspected. The presence of a reference does not establish that it contains self-check exercises.
use: Further reading for each framework row, including the separate references associated with transposing theory.

title: Systems thinking practitioner, ST0787 version 1.2
check: Current version page inspected on 7 September 2026; version effective from 20 February 2025.
use: Check K1-K5, S1-S11, B1-B9 and duties. The pack supports rehearsal, not an end-point assessment decision.

title: OU: drawing systems maps, SAQ 3 and Activities 19-22
check: Tasks, defective maps, answer text and worked revisions inspected. Historic Child Support Agency case, not current policy guidance.
use: Attempt SAQ 3 before opening its answer. Draw your own map for Activities 19-22, then compare the author's choices. Different justified boundaries need not match the example.

title: OU: systems diagramming
check: Course content inspected. An old Flash activity is unavailable; do not depend on it.
use: Use the text conventions and printable activities. Use the newer systems-map tutorial below instead of the Flash element.

title: OU: systems maps, updated tutorial
check: Updated 2021 tutorial page and diagram conventions inspected; playback not independently tested.
use: Check containment and boundaries. An OU systems map is not a causal-loop diagram; do not add untyped causal arrows to it.

title: OU: soft systems approach, stages 1-7
check: The stage pages were inspected, including root definitions and activity models. This is an adapted teaching account, not a complete self-marking SSM course.
use: Read stages 3-5 beside your own root definition, activity model and comparison table. Use this pack's case and checks to test your construction.

title: MIT: System Dynamics Self Study, assignments and solutions
check: Assignment/solution pairs on the MIT page inspected. Historic software instructions may need adaptation; the whole course was not executed.
use: Start with the early assignments and their paired solutions. Predict behaviour, calculate it, then compare. Do not confuse this course with MIT courses that publish assignments without solutions.

title: Werner Ulrich: a mini-primer of critical systems heuristics
check: Author's HTML guide and linked introduction inspected. It supplies boundary critique, not a unique correct policy answer.
use: Use the twelve categories to challenge your is/ought table and your treatment of affected people. Follow the linked primer for depth.

title: OU repository: evaluation using critical systems heuristics
check: Repository abstract and download listing inspected; the accepted manuscript is linked there.
use: Study the operational use of CSH in evaluation and compare its boundary judgements with your own. No automated marking.

title: Metaphorum: VSM mapping and editable diagrams
check: Diagram links and Jon Walker's editing instructions inspected. Templates are not an answer validator.
use: Use the editable diagrams after identifying your focal system, operational units and channels. A completed template is not evidence that the diagnosis is sound.

title: SCiO systems practice courses
check: Public listings inspected for VSM, SSM, CSH, SD, Patterns of Strategy, Mosaic and systems laws. Paid exercises and marking were not accessed.
use: Choose the named introduction or core module matching your method. Check current price, access arrangements and feedback provision before paying.

title: SCiO professional development and course enquiries
check: The page lists coverage including CONAN, INFORMED and multi-methodology. Availability and individual tutor feedback require an enquiry.
use: Ask for practice with feedback in the named approach, rather than assuming every recording includes assessment.

title: SCiO: Mosaic, multi-methodology, CONAN and INFORMED
check: Method descriptions and linked talks/books inspected. Provider claims about success rates are not adopted by this pack.
use: Use for orientation and source discovery. It is not a free self-check workbook; use the original exercises here.

title: Natalie Marguet: organisational decision-making, a personal construct perspective
check: University thesis record and abstract inspected; full thesis not represented as fully reviewed.
use: Ground the distinction between individual constructs, group interaction and organisational decisions. The exercise here is an introductory rehearsal, not the author's complete protocol.

title: Natalie Marguet: what lies beneath managers' decisions
check: Resource description and video link inspected, not the full recording.
use: Follow the connection between personal constructs, repertory grids and organisational choices. Do not infer motives from a grid alone.

title: Russell Ackoff: a brief guide to interactive planning and idealized design
check: Public page and 15-page guide listing inspected. This is a process guide rather than a self-marking case.
use: Follow the planning phases and constraints on idealised design, using this pack's scenario and comparison answer.

title: Warfield IP Trust: Interactive Management handbook
check: The author's trust lists the handbook but says a digital download is not available there. Do not label this particular link a free full text.
use: Locate the handbook or ask about access. It distinguishes proper Interactive Management from loosely structured group discussion.

title: SCiO: A Handbook of Interactive Management
check: SCiO lists a free PDF route and second-hand availability. The trust's record differs; full download availability is therefore not guaranteed here.
use: Try the access route, but rely on the original mini-ISM exercise here when access fails. Check seller stock and rights yourself.

title: Demosophia: collective intelligence through structured dialogue
check: SCiO presentation description and attachment listing inspected.
use: Follow the relationship between Interactive Management and Structured Dialogic Design. A five-element structural model rehearses only part of the group process.

title: SCiO: Mosaic transformation course
check: Public course description inspected; exercises behind the learning platform were not purchased or tested.
use: Further practice in sequencing change and releasing capacity. Verify the current offer and feedback arrangements.

title: SCiO: Patterns of Strategy
check: Public method account inspected. The full pattern catalogue is not reproduced here.
use: Check how strategy depends on relationships, relative power, fit and timing; then test your dependency model.

title: SCiO: Patterns of Strategy, developing strategy
check: Course description inspected; paid content not accessed.
use: Continue from introductory relationship modelling to the fuller method and its pattern repertoire.

title: Eric Trist: the evolution of socio-technical systems
check: Public resource page and article attachment listing inspected. Historic work, not a ready-made answer key.
use: Read the primary-work-system discussion alongside the joint-design exercise. Keep technical arrangements and human work interdependent.

title: Enid Mumford: an ethical approach to socio-technical design
check: Publisher abstract and access status inspected; subscription chapter not read in full.
use: Further study of participation and the social and technical requirements of design.

title: Malik Syntegration: facilitated service
check: Provider's current service page inspected. Promotional claims of universal success are not treated as evidence.
use: For a full facilitated process, ask about design, participation, licensing, outputs and evaluation. The structural rehearsal here is not a branded delivery substitute.

title: Jon Walker: Viable Systems Model guide
check: Bibliographic route identified; direct access was not confirmed in this research environment.
use: A useful further route when reachable. This pack provides its own case and answer so access failure does not stop practice.
